name: Unload Agent Context
description: Deliberately remove agent-managed persistent context. Accepts only exact map keys from a loaded_context result; use paths to remove several together. Never pass a display label, a source or operation path from pinned_context, or an argument from an ordinary tool call. Ordinary results such as covia_read and covia_inspect belong to conversation history, are not persistent loads, and need no cleanup. Operator/caller pinned_context cannot be removed.

path.description: One exact key from the loaded_context result map

paths.description: Several exact keys from the loaded_context result map, removed together in one call
